title: 어미의 사전적 처리
author: 임동훈
paraphrase: The article treats ri followed by ni or ra as a prefinal construction. It distinguishes formal rida and rikka: their historical contraction includes listener politeness, so it argues against reducing rida to the ordinary conjectural marker plus plain da. This supports investigating the missing rini lemma paths while retaining the implemented rida bundle. The article does not independently settle which current KRDict ni homonym should label each preserved example.
implementation_implication: Do not replace the rida bundle or add a plain-ri+da decomposition solely because the prefinal entry lists rida among its surface uses. Review ri+ni using complete following-ending homonyms and preserve existing ri+ra and rida paths.
